stance_rationale: The v2 package fixes the prior universe/liquidity breach, but the actual alpha still fails every graduation gate and relies on unverified PIT carve-out and downstream PG2 validation. A discovery artifact can be honest and still be non-admissible.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is multi-date, but five calendar months are missing and requested weights.csv is absent, so downstream schedule usage cannot be cleared.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: factor_engine_proposal.R raw-reads daily factor parquet and does not use Z_Score_Aligned; N_A_BY_CARVE_OUT is not accepted by the required alpha prompt.
No Usable_Date <= sig_date filter is shown for raw daily factor features or KR FF5 cache lineage.
Code uses arrow::open_dataset on .cache/factor_db_daily and read_parquet on .cache/kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet; load_month_factors() is not used.
Regime uses vol_252_lag := shift(vol_252, 1L) before expanding percentile.
Financial statement lag is asserted as daily factor DB PIT-safe, but no annual-May or quarterly-45d proof is attached.

critical_concerns.description: The package reports 0/5 graduation gates passed: rank_IC 0.0122 < 0.04, ICIR 0.0856 < 0.20, sub_stab 0.0153 < 0.50, Harvey_NW 1.0561 < 3.0, and DSR -2.3567 < 0.50. This is not a deployable alpha candidate under the WT's own criteria.

Diagnostics are not consistently computed on the saved production score after EMA smoothing: recomputed saved score_ens gives IC 0.0106, ICIR 0.0742, NW t 0.9238, and DSR proxy -2.5123. CatBoost alone has ICIR 0.1140, above the ensemble raw 0.0856 and smoothed ensemble 0.0742, so RF-A2 is triggered.

The package treats C13/C14/C15 as N_A_BY_CARVE_OUT, but the required prompt demands Z_Score_Aligned, Usable_Date <= sig_date, and load_month_factors(). Local L-164 registry also describes direct factor parquet access as a hard-block pattern, so the carve-out is not sufficient evidence.

The core claim is PG2 diversification, but M06 vs STR_1701 correlation, TDC, crisis_alpha, bad/normal IC ratio, and blended realized SR are all deferred to Forge/S6. AX-007 multi-sleeve exception is asserted, not demonstrated with actual weights.

The user-requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260426_006 path, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, risk_package, and optimization_package are absent. RF-A7 schedule usage, PSD, and condition-number checks cannot be triangulated.

alpha_scores has 187 signal dates and is not a single snapshot, but the schedule has five missing calendar months and max date gaps of 63 days. The package should explain these gaps before downstream walk-forward validation.

References are mostly broad section citations, while the economic mechanism is labeled only as behavioral/risk_premium/structural. KR-specific causality for why this ML ensemble survives long-only K200/KQ150 constraints is not established.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet exists with Date x Ticker x score columns, 59,856 rows, 187 signal dates, and last sig_date 2023-12-28, so the alpha artifact itself is not single-snapshot.
Universe and liquidity remediation are materially improved: latest top20 are 20/20 in KOSPI200 or KOSDAQ150 and all saved rows have AvgTV20 >= 2e8 KRW.
Turnover proxy is 325.5% annual after EMA smoothing, below the 600% hard cap.
C9 and C10 have visible t-1 lag implementations in code.
unresolved_disputes: Whether any L-164 v1.1 ML daily carve-out can override the role prompt's mandatory C13/C14/C15 checks.
Whether the saved smoothed score_ens or pre-EMA score_ens_raw is the authoritative alpha for IC diagnostics.
Whether M06 improves PG2 blended SR, correlation, crisis behavior, and bad/normal IC ratio after real weights and costs.
Whether the missing weights.csv and covariance.parquet exist in another location or were never produced.
Whether sector-neutral IC would retain enough signal; post_neutralization_ic is copied from overall IC rather than independently measured.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a PG2 20% diversifier role can rescue an alpha that fails standalone IC, ICIR, Harvey, DSR, and stability gates without measured M06 weights, correlation, or crisis evidence.
rebuttal_required: Recompute all IC diagnostics on the exact saved production score_ens used for alpha_vector and downstream optimization.
Report RF-A2 using measured XGB-only, CatBoost-only, raw ensemble, and smoothed ensemble metrics.
Provide explicit C13/C14/C15 proof or an approved carve-out artifact that supersedes the required prompt and L-164 hard-block language.
Provide M06 vs STR_1701 correlation, TDC, crisis_alpha, bad/normal IC ratio, and PG2 blended realized SR under 15bps costs.
Produce weights.csv and covariance.parquet or mark RF-A7/AX-008 unresolved.
rationalization_red_flags: No exact base auto-flag phrase was used as the sole defense, but exact phrases appear in audit/prohibition text.
PG2 blended SR realized = Forge 영역.
본질 평가는 PG2 blended Realized SR.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Alpha v2 is more honest than v1, but AX-008 cannot pass because the decisive PG2, Risk, Optimizer, weights, and covariance artifacts are missing or deferred.

alpha_specific_questions: 이 factor가 KR market에서 t_NW > 2.95와 DSR >= 0.50을 saved score_ens 기준으로 유지할 수 있는가?
alpha vector 시계열에 future leakage 없는가, 특히 raw daily factor와 FF5 cache의 Usable_Date <= sig_date 증빙이 있는가?
AX-007 예외에 의존한다면 실제 paired multi-sleeve weights schedule과 turnover/correlation/crowding evidence가 있는가?
왜 CatBoost-only ICIR이 ensemble보다 높은데 ensemble을 선택했는가?
